title: Tech Mahindra Opens Consumer Agentic Experience Studio in Hyderabad
excerpt: The IT services giant launches its CAX Studio to help enterprises deploy AI-driven consumer engagement across the value chain, building on a string of agentic AI initiatives in 2026.
body:
• Tech Mahindra has launched the Consumer Agentic Experience Studio (CAX Studio) in Hyderabad, focused on AI-led transformation of consumer-facing business operations.
  • The studio joins a growing portfolio of agentic AI facilities, including a Communications Experience Center in Pune and partnerships with NVIDIA, Microsoft, and mimik.
  • India's IT services sector is rapidly pivoting to agentic AI as enterprise clients seek autonomous systems that can reason, act, and learn across customer touchpoints.

Tech Mahindra has launched its Consumer Agentic Experience Studio, dubbed CAX Studio, in Hyderabad — the latest in a series of facilities the $4.9 billion IT services company is building to help enterprises deploy autonomous AI systems at scale.

The CAX Studio is designed to accelerate AI-led transformation of the consumer value chain, bringing together agentic AI capabilities with Tech Mahindra's consulting and systems integration expertise across industries including retail, consumer goods, telecommunications, and financial services.

Agentic AI: The Next Enterprise Frontier

Unlike conventional AI deployments that require human prompting for each action, agentic AI systems are designed to reason across multiple data signals, take autonomous actions, and continuously learn to improve their recommendations. For consumer-facing businesses, this translates into AI agents that can manage end-to-end customer journeys — from personalized marketing and dynamic pricing to automated service resolution and proactive engagement.

The CAX Studio in Hyderabad serves as both a demonstration center and a co-creation environment where enterprise clients can work with Tech Mahindra's teams to prototype, test, and deploy consumer-focused agentic solutions before committing to full-scale rollouts.

Part of a Broader Agentic Push

The Hyderabad launch fits into a pronounced strategic pivot by Tech Mahindra toward agentic AI. In April 2026, the company opened its Communications Experience Center in Pune, focused on helping telecom operators rethink customer experience and network operations through agentic workflows. In June, it launched Agentic Development and Modernization Services, a portfolio that integrates autonomous AI across the application lifecycle.

Tech Mahindra has also formed a series of partnerships to deepen its agentic capabilities. A collaboration with Microsoft launched an ontology-driven agentic AI platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI Foundry. A joint venture with mimik established an Agentic AI Production Center for deploying AI agents across physical devices including smartphones, drones, and industrial sensors. And an AI Center of Excellence with NVIDIA, housed within Tech Mahindra's Makers Lab in both Pune and Hyderabad, focuses on generative AI, large language models, and digital twins.

"Communications Service Providers are at a defining moment as they navigate rising complexity alongside the need for sustainable growth. Our centers serve as nerve centers where enterprises can rethink growth, agentic operations, and customer experience."

— Amol Phadke, Chief Transformation Officer, Tech Mahindra

Why Hyderabad

Hyderabad has emerged as one of India's premier technology hubs, home to major operations of global IT companies and an expanding ecosystem of AI startups. Tech Mahindra already maintains significant operations in the city, including its NVIDIA-powered Makers Lab. The choice of Hyderabad for the CAX Studio positions the facility close to both talent pools and enterprise clients with large consumer operations.

The studio is expected to focus initially on sectors where consumer experience is a primary competitive differentiator — retail, banking, telecommunications, and healthcare — before expanding to other verticals.

A Competitive Landscape

Tech Mahindra is not alone in the race. Indian IT peers including Infosys, Wipro, TCS, and HCLTech have all announced agentic AI offerings in recent months, reflecting strong enterprise demand for autonomous systems. Everest Group has noted that the application services market is "entering a more agentic phase, where enterprises are increasingly looking beyond traditional automation toward AI-enabled delivery models."

For Tech Mahindra, part of the Mahindra Group with 147,000 employees across 90 countries, the CAX Studio represents an effort to differentiate through vertical-specific agentic solutions rather than competing on platform scale alone. The company's strategy, branded "AI Delivered Right," emphasizes governed, production-grade AI that enterprises can deploy with confidence.
